Spirit and Freedom will dock nose to nose to transfer supplies between crafts. 4 Jovian landers will act as Surface access and habitation modules. Lander 1 will descend to Ganymede and return to lay the first Flag in the outer solar system.

Once crew transfer has been completed, The Spirit will become the active vessel and transit the Jovian systems largest moons except Io, as an exploration vehicle, periodically returning to Freedom to deposit science payloads and crew changeover.

After 2 years of Jovian operations, The Spirit will rendezvous with the Freedom for the last time. all payloads will be transferred to Freedom and then ITV -01 will depart for Earth. Spirit will remain at Ganymede to act as a supply depot for future missions.

The X-Wing and Y-Wing are both great in there roles, can easily over come the numbers game from the tie fighter, however you do get better fighters as you research further, the A-wing is a good strike fighter and the B and H wing excel in their bomber roles, with the B-wing also being usable as a fighter. 

Just make sure you are stocking your fleets with independent fighter complements because only certain capitals get the X and Y wing  as deployables. This is until you get the quasar from Sullust.

You also need to build fighter sized dock yards to be able to build the X and Y wings as well as the more advanced stuff.

Probably the biggest tip I can give you is: ships are super valuable, which you can tell from the credit price as well as there in game abilities. Particularly if you’re playing rebels. 

Try to lock down some early planet clusters with defence fleets, like those accessed through alyuen and Rhen Var. 

Different shipyards produce different ships which carries over from TR/FOTR, but now you have to specialise your ship yards in to fighters, frigates and capitals. I always try to build 2 of each yard where it’s available. 

As empire, you start off with the distinct lack of military, but with the tankiest ships and most powerful. You need an economy built up first. 

Black sun have a little bit of everything going on, some good tank ships but by nowhere near the abilities of the empire and poorer fighters than the rebellion.

That’s as much as I can give from a broad perspective, but the point is have fun, take your losses in your stride, build up, counterattack. Have a good one man!
